uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When the user deals damage with auto attacks or moves, vibes increase, which increase Attack by 5% per stack up to 3. If no vibes are gained within 3s, they are lost, along with the user's boosted gauge. After evolving into Quaquaval, the next auto attack when vibes are maxed becomes Spinning Edge. Each time Spinning Edge hits opposing Pokémon, the user's movement speed is increased by 15% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times.

The user kicks at opposing Pokémon dealing damage. Becomes a boosted attack every third attack, with the user stepping in for a kick with increased damage. Spinning Edge deals damage 3 times in an area around the user over time, before rapidly dealing damage 3 more times. If Low Sweep was used preceding Spinning Edge, then it will do increased damage. If Liquidation was used preceding Spinning Edge, then it will grant a shield on use. If Carnival Splash was used preceding Spinning Edge, it will gain both effects.
12% of Max HP 15% of Max HP
The user pounds the area, dealing damage and slowing opposing Pokémon by 30% for 2s.

The user unleashes three swift kicks in the designated direction, dealing damage and slowing opposing Pokémon by 60% for 1s, decaying by 15% every 0.25s. The third kick can be aimed, launching the user in that direction before unleashing the kick.
Increases the damage of this move, and Spinning Edge when this move precedes it.
The user lunges in the designated direction dealing damage, and gaining a shield for 3s on hit.

The user charges in the designated direction, dealing damage, lowering the defense of opposing Pokémon by 30% for 3s, and restoring the user's HP. Two uses can be kept in reserve, with a 0.5s cooldown between uses. 10% of Max HP
Increases the amount of health this move restores, and increases Spinning Edge's shield when this move precedes it. 12% of Max HP

The user becomes Unstoppable while dancing in place, gaining a shield and dealing damage to opposing Pokémon up to 3 times. The third hit will pull in opposing Pokémon towards the user, stunning them for 1s. Each opposing Pokémon pulled in grants the user a shield, up to 3 times. The third hit of this move will not affect wild Pokémon.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
